STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_06736_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_06736_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_06736 (

                       address,
                       byteenable,
                       chipselect,
                       clk,
                       clken,
                       freeze,
                       reset,
                       reset_req,
                       write,
                       writedata,
                       readdata
                    )
;
  parameter INIT_FILE = "lab9_soc_ocm.hex";

  output reg [ 31: 0] readdata;
  input      [  9: 0] address;
  input      [  3: 0] byteenable;
  input               chipselect;
  input               clk;
  input               clken;
  input               freeze;
  input               reset;
  input               reset_req;
  input               write;
  input      [ 31: 0] writedata;

  reg [31:0] memory [0:1023]; // Memory array with 1024 words of 32 bits each
  wire clocken0;
  wire wren;
  integer i;

  assign wren = chipselect & write;
  assign clocken0 = clken & ~reset_req;

  // Initializing memory from the file
  initial
  begin
    if (INIT_FILE != "")
      $readmemh(INIT_FILE, memory);
  end

  always @(posedge clk)
  begin
    if (clocken0) 
    begin
      if (wren)
      begin
        // Handle byte enable logic while writing to memory
        for (i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1) begin
          if (byteenable[i])
            memory[address][(i*8)+:8] = writedata[(i*8)+:8];
        end
      end
      readdata <= memory[address];
    end
  end
endmodule
